literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: Ad5-ZIKV-E mut免疫小鼠诱导的JEV交叉反应性或DENV交叉反应性抗体水平低于Ad5-ZIKV-E WT免疫小鼠。Ad5-ZIKV-E mut诱导的抗体在体外增强JEV或DENV感染的能力也较Ad5-ZIKV-E WT有所减弱。 [10.1128/spectrum.01620-26]
本研究确定了与登革病毒感染相关的周围神经系统并发症的范围,包括单神经病、多发性神经病和吉兰-巴雷综合征,这些并发症在暴发期间的患者中被观察到。 [10.1177/00494755261506378]
在患有眼科异常和任何临床或影像学异常的妊娠中,观察到新生儿抗DENV IgG反应较低,且这两种关联在假发现率调整后仍保持显著。 [10.1111/1348-0421.70105]
两种格式均能扩增所有六种ivRNA标准品,且无交叉扩增,其配对的双靶-多靶Ct差异均小于±1.41。对于最近流行的菌株标准品(AF_2020和MY_2024),两种格式的分析灵敏度相当(LoD95分别约为211.7和8.3拷贝/反应)。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11610819/v1]
限制作用与TRIM5α和TRIM56表达细胞中病毒RNA和病毒蛋白水平的降低相关。 [10.64898/2026.11.16.767120]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The levels of JEV-cross-reactive or DENV-cross-reactive antibody responses induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut immunization in mice are lower than those induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT. [10.1128/spectrum.01620-26]

The study identified a range of peripheral neurological complications associated with dengue virus infection, including mononeuropathy, polyneuropathy, and Guillain-Barré syndrome, observed in patients during the outbreak period. [10.1177/00494755261506378]

Lower neonatal anti-DENV IgG reactivity was observed in pregnancies with ophthalmological abnormalities and with any clinical or imaging abnormality, and both associations remained significant after false discovery rate adjustment. [10.1111/1348-0421.70105]

Both formats amplified all six ivRNA standards without cross-amplification, with paired dual–multiplex Ct differences below ± 1.41. For the most recent circulating standards (AF_2020 and MY_2024), analytical sensitivity was comparable between formats (LoD95 ≈ 211.7 and 8.3 copies/reaction, respectively). [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11610819/v1]
Restriction correlated with reduced viral RNA and viral protein levels in TRIM5α- and TRIM56-expressing cells. [10.64898/2026.11.16.767120]

literature.en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments. The levels of JEV-cross-reactive or DENV-cross-reactive antibody responses induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut immunization in mice are lower than those induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT. [10.1128/spectrum.01620-26]. The study identified a range of peripheral neurological complications associated with dengue virus infection, including mononeuropathy, polyneuropathy, and Guillain-Barré syndrome, observed in patients during the outbreak period. Lower neonatal anti-DENV IgG reactivity was observed in pregnancies with ophthalmological abnormalities and with any clinical or imaging abnormality, and both associations remained significant after false discovery rate adjustment. Both formats amplified all six ivRNA standards without cross-amplification, with paired dual–multiplex Ct differences below ± 1.41.

news.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 报告了一起登革热暴发疫情,疑似病例定义为急性发热性疾病持续超过2天并符合特定临床标准的个体,确诊病例则需要通过实验室检测登革病毒或特异性抗原/抗体来确认。 [news-fc2a5127c35cb2fe]

登革病毒暴发在马绍尔群岛、萨摩亚和瓦努阿图被报告。马绍尔群岛在615份检测样本中发现了173例阳性病例(确认和可能病例),其中最后确认的病例在马朱罗岛发病时间为10月18日。在瓦努阿图,从EpiWeek 41到45期间报告了259例新的实验室确认病例,暴发仍在持续并受到密切监测。报告还提到了澳大利亚的一例麻疹病例和瓦努阿图的一例百日咳暴发,但这些并非主要关注点。 [news-e19885147e199de1]
2026年第42流行病学周,美洲地区共报告了1,914,591例疑似登革热病例,由PAHO发布。 [news-4990514e5bc30757]
一名登革热患者病情危重,出现了严重并发症,包括血小板减少、肝损伤和凝血障碍。国家热带病医院的医生警告称,该疾病可能表现出病情恶化的迹象,并存在重症登革热出血热的风险。 [news-88ed467cd3ea4fe6]
美属萨摩亚报告了一次登革热暴发,2025年6月至2026年8月期间共有1,048例确诊病例和371例住院。CDC与美属萨摩亚卫生部门合作确认病例并实施控制策略。 [news-8c347a804a420249]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Dengue virus news developments.
key_findings_en: A dengue outbreak was reported, with suspected cases defined by acute fever illness lasting more than 2 days and meeting specific clinical criteria, and confirmed cases requiring laboratory testing for dengue virus or specific antigens/antibodies. [news-fc2a5127c35cb2fe]

Dengue outbreaks were reported in the Marshall Islands, Samoa, and Vanuatu. The Marshall Islands had 173 positive cases (confirmed and probable) among 615 specimens tested, with the last confirmed case on Majuro having onset on 18 October. [news-e19885147e199de1]
A total of 1,914,591 suspected dengue cases were reported in the Region of the Americas during epidemiological week 42, 2026, by PAHO. [news-4990514e5bc30757]

A dengue fever patient in critical condition was reported, with severe complications including low platelet counts, liver damage, and coagulation disorders. Doctors at the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases warned about the signs of worsening condition and the risks of severe dengue hemorrhagic fever. [news-88ed467cd3ea4fe6]

An outbreak of dengue virus was reported in American Samoa, with 1,048 confirmed cases and 371 hospitalizations between June 2025 and August 2026. The CDC and American Samoa Department of Health collaborated to confirm cases and implement vector control strategies. [news-8c347a804a420249]

papers.title: Progress on Dengue Vaccines: A Comprehensive Review of Current and Emerging Vaccines
papers.abstract: Abstract The global burden of dengue virus continues to increase, driven by environmental changes, urban growth, and the widespread dissemination of Aedes mosquito vectors. Developing an effective dengue vaccine remains challenging because it must provide long-lasting, balanced immunity against each of the four circulating serotypes without increasing the risk of immune-mediated disease enhancement upon exposure to a different serotype. This review article summarizes current understanding of dengue immunopathogenesis, highlights the limitations of first-generation, live-attenuated vaccines, and explores how preexisting serostatus, efficacy across serotypes, and safety considerations affect vaccine implementation. We also review emerging vaccine platforms, including site-directed attenuation, heterologous prime-boost strategies, and mRNA, DNA, and peptide vaccines. Advances in antigen engineering, together with improved diagnostics and surveillance, will be essential to overcoming existing immunologic and implementation barriers. Ongoing innovation, equitable access, and public trust remain critical to achieving effective global dengue control.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on dengue virus and dengue disease, specifically examining the challenges of developing an effective vaccine that provides long-lasting immunity against all four serotypes without causing immune-mediated disease enhancement. The central question is how preexisting serostatus, efficacy across serotypes, and safety considerations influence vaccine implementation.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a comprehensive analysis of dengue immunopathogenesis and vaccine development. It includes a discussion of first-generation, live-attenuated vaccines and explores emerging platforms such as site-directed attenuation, heterologous prime-boost strategies, and mRNA, DNA, and peptide vaccines. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or consensus processes, but it provides a detailed overview of the field.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that first-generation vaccines have limitations, particularly in balancing immunity across serotypes and avoiding disease enhancement. It also emphasizes the importance of understanding immunopathogenesis and the role of preexisting serostatus in vaccine effectiveness. Emerging vaccine platforms are discussed as potential solutions to these challenges.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is heterogeneity in vaccine efficacy across serotypes and concerns about immune-mediated disease enhancement. The review notes that these issues remain unresolved, and there is a lack of consensus on the best strategies to address them. Additionally, the review identifies gaps in understanding the mechanisms of immune enhancement and the long-term safety of vaccines.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that advances in antigen engineering, along with improved diagnostics and surveillance, are essential to overcoming existing immunologic and implementation barriers. It also calls for ongoing innovation, equitable access, and public trust to achieve effective global dengue control.

analysis.summary_en: This review article provides an in-depth analysis of dengue virus and its associated diseases, focusing on the development of effective vaccines. It outlines the challenges of creating vaccines that offer balanced immunity against all four serotypes without increasing the risk of disease enhancement. The review highlights the limitations of first-generation vaccines and explores emerging platforms such as site-directed attenuation, heterologous prime-boost strategies, and mRNA, DNA, and peptide vaccines. It also identifies controversies and evidence gaps, particularly regarding immune-mediated disease enhancement and vaccine safety. The article concludes with implications for future research and public health strategies, emphasizing the need for antigen engineering, improved diagnostics, and equitable vaccine access to achieve global dengue control.

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议,抗原工程领域的进展,结合更先进的诊断技术和疫苗技术,是克服现有免疫学和实施障碍的关键。它还呼吁持续的创新、公平的疫苗获取以及公众信任,以实现有效的全球登革热控制。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革病毒的全球负担持续增加,这主要由环境变化、城市化发展以及埃及伊蚊的广泛传播所驱动。开发一种有效的登革热疫苗仍然具有挑战性,因为其必须提供对四种流行血清型的持久、均衡的免疫力,同时避免在接触不同血清型时引发免疫介导的疾病增强风险。本文综述了当前对登革热免疫发病机制的理解,强调了第一代减毒活疫苗的局限性,并探讨了既往血清型状态、疫苗对各血清型的效力以及安全性考量如何影响疫苗的实施。我们还回顾了新兴疫苗平台,包括定点减毒、异源加强策略以及mRNA、DNA和肽疫苗。抗原工程领域的进展,结合更先进的诊断技术和疫苗技术,将是克服现有免疫学和实施障碍的关键。持续的创新、公平的疫苗获取以及公众信任对于实现有效的全球登革热控制至关重要。

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对登革热免疫发病机制及疫苗开发的全面分析。它讨论了第一代减毒活疫苗,并探讨了新兴平台,如定点减毒、异源加强策略以及mRNA、DNA和肽疫苗。综述未明确报告元分析或共识过程,但提供了该领域的详细概述。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述指出,第一代疫苗存在局限性,尤其是在对各血清型提供均衡免疫力和避免疾病增强方面。它还强调了理解免疫发病机制以及既往血清型状态对疫苗效果的重要性。新兴疫苗平台被讨论为解决这些挑战的潜在方案。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 疫苗对各血清型的效力存在异质性,且对免疫介导疾病增强的担忧仍然存在。综述指出,这些问题尚未解决,且在最佳策略方面缺乏共识。此外,综述还指出了对免疫增强机制和疫苗长期安全性的理解存在不足。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议,抗原工程领域的进展,结合更先进的诊断技术和疫苗技术,是克服现有免疫学和实施障碍的关键。它还呼吁持续的创新、公平的疫苗获取以及公众信任,以实现有效的全球登革热控制。

papers.title: Therapeutic plasma exchange and continuous renal replacement therapy for severe dengue with multiorgan failure: a case report and focused review.
papers.abstract: Severe dengue can progress to acute liver failure, haemolysis, encephalopathy, shock, and multiorgan dysfunction, but the role of therapeutic plasma exchange in treatment remains uncertain. We report a 17-year-old adolescent with NS1-positive dengue managed with continuous renal replacement therapy, therapeutic plasma exchange, and comprehensive intensive care, and provide a focused narrative review of therapeutic plasma exchange in severe dengue. The patient developed abrupt massive intravascular haemolysis, profound anaemia, thrombocytopenia, coagulopathy, encephalopathy requiring invasive mechanical ventilation, oliguric acute kidney injury, shock, and acute liver failure. She also met five of eight HLH-2004 criteria for secondary haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis. Continuous renal replacement therapy was initiated before three therapeutic plasma exchange sessions, beginning with an exchange of 1·5 estimated plasma volumes using fresh frozen plasma. Haemodynamic, hepatic, renal, and coagulation parameters subsequently improved. Secondary infection and haemothorax requiring video-assisted thoracoscopic drainage complicated recovery; she was discharged 38 days after admission. Published evidence on the use of therapeutic plasma exchange in severe dengue consists mainly of case reports, small series, and observational cohorts. Therapeutic plasma exchange can be considered an adjunctive rescue therapy in selected refractory cases, particularly acute liver failure or thrombotic microangiopathy phenotypes, but its independent benefit, optimal timing, prescription, and target population remain undefined.
authors: Felipe Medauar Reis de Andrade Moreira

papers.title_original: Therapeutic plasma exchange and continuous renal replacement therapy for severe dengue with multiorgan failure: a case report and focused review.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on severe dengue with multiorgan failure, specifically examining the role of therapeutic plasma exchange as a treatment modality. The central question is whether therapeutic plasma exchange is effective in managing severe dengue, particularly in cases involving acute liver failure, haemolysis, encephalopathy, shock, and multiorgan dysfunction.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base consists of a case report and a focused narrative review. The review does not include systematic or meta-analytic methods, but rather relies on a single case study and existing literature. The included studies are primarily case reports, small series, and observational cohorts, with no explicit mention of meta-analysis or consensus processes.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that therapeutic plasma exchange can be considered an adjunctive rescue therapy in selected refractory cases of severe dengue, particularly those involving acute liver failure or thrombotic microangiopathy phenotypes. However, the independent benefit, optimal timing, prescription, and target population for this therapy remain undefined.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence on therapeutic plasma exchange for severe dengue is limited to case reports and small observational studies, which may not provide sufficient data to establish its efficacy or optimal use. There is also uncertainty regarding its role in treatment and whether it should be used as a primary or secondary intervention.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to define the independent benefit, optimal timing, prescription, and target population for therapeutic plasma exchange in severe dengue. This includes larger, randomized controlled trials to assess its effectiveness and safety in specific clinical scenarios.

analysis.summary_en: This review presents a case report of a 17-year-old adolescent with severe dengue managed with continuous renal replacement therapy and therapeutic plasma exchange. The review highlights the complexity of severe dengue, which can lead to multiorgan failure, and discusses the potential role of therapeutic plasma exchange as an adjunctive therapy. However, the evidence is limited to case reports and small observational studies, leaving key questions about its efficacy, optimal timing, and target population unresolved. The review underscores the need for further research to clarify the use of therapeutic plasma exchange in severe dengue cases, particularly those involving acute liver failure or thrombotic microangiopathy phenotypes.

elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence on therapeutic plasma exchange for severe dengue is limited to case reports and small observational studies, which may not provide sufficient data to establish its efficacy or optimal use. There is also uncertainty regarding its role in treatment and whether it should be used as a primary or secondary intervention.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to define the independent benefit, optimal timing, prescription, and target population for therapeutic plasma exchange in severe dengue. This includes larger, randomized controlled trials to assess its effectiveness and safety in specific clinical scenarios.

papers.title_zh: 治疗性血浆置换和连续肾脏替代治疗用于登革热伴多器官衰竭的病例:病例报告与重点综述
papers.source_body_en: Severe dengue can progress to acute liver failure, haemolysis, encephalopathy, shock, and multiorgan dysfunction, but the role of therapeutic plasma exchange in treatment remains uncertain. We report a 17-year-old adolescent with NS1-positive dengue managed with continuous renal replacement therapy, therapeutic plasma exchange, and comprehensive intensive care, and provide a focused narrative review of therapeutic plasma exchange in severe dengue. The patient developed abrupt massive intravascular haemolysis, profound anaemia, thrombocytopenia, coagulopathy, encephalopathy requiring invasive mechanical ventilation, oliguric acute kidney injury, shock, and acute liver failure. She also met five of eight HLH-2004 criteria for secondary haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis. Continuous renal replacement therapy was initiated before three therapeutic plasma exchange sessions, beginning with an exchange of 1·5 estimated plasma volumes using fresh frozen plasma. Haemodynamic, hepatic, renal, and coagulation parameters subsequently improved. Secondary infection and haemothorax requiring video-assisted thoracoscopic drainage complicated recovery; she was discharged 38 days after admission. Published evidence on the use of therapeutic plasma exchange in severe dengue consists mainly of case reports, small series, and observational cohorts. Therapeutic plasma exchange can be considered an adjunctive rescue therapy in selected refractory cases, particularly acute liver failure or thrombotic microangiopathy phenotypes, but its independent benefit, optimal timing, prescription, and target population remain undefined.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热可进展为急性肝衰竭、溶血、脑病、休克和多器官功能障碍,但治疗性血浆置换在登革热治疗中的作用仍不确定。我们报告了一例17岁青少年登革热病例,其NS1阳性,接受了连续肾脏替代治疗、治疗性血浆置换和全面的重症监护,并提供了治疗性血浆置换在登革热伴多器官衰竭中的重点叙述性综述。该患者出现了急性血管内溶血、严重贫血、血小板减少、凝血功能障碍、需要侵入性机械通气的脑病、少尿性急性肾损伤、休克和急性肝衰竭。她还符合2004年HLH标准中8项中的5项,提示存在继发性噬血细胞性淋巴组织组织细胞增生症。在进行三次治疗性血浆置换之前,开始使用连续肾脏替代治疗,首次置换量为估计血浆体积的1·5倍,使用新鲜冰冻血浆。随后,血流动力学、肝脏、肾脏和凝血参数均有所改善。继发感染和需要视频辅助胸腔镜引流的血胸使康复过程复杂化;患者在入院38天后出院。目前关于治疗性血浆置换在登革热伴多器官衰竭中的应用证据主要来自病例报告、小样本系列研究和观察性队列研究。治疗性血浆置换可被视为某些难治性登革热病例的辅助挽救性治疗,特别是那些表现为急性肝衰竭或血栓性微血管病的病例,但其独立疗效、最佳时机、用药方案和适用人群仍不明确。

papers.title: Peripheral neurological complications associated with dengue virus infection: A retrospective case series
papers.abstract: Neurological complications of dengue remain incompletely characterized. We retrospectively describe adults evaluated at a tertiary neurological referral centre during Argentina's 2023-2024 outbreak with peripheral neurological syndromes temporally associated with laboratory-supported or clinically suspected dengue.

papers.title: A combined molecular strategy for robust detection and rapid clade classification of sylvatic dengue virus 2 (DENV-2/GVI)
papers.abstract: Abstract Background. The sylvatic genotype of dengue virus 2 (DENV-2/GVI) circulates between non-human primates and forest mosquitoes in West Africa and Asia, but spillover infections to humans have been documented in Senegal and Malaysia. These strains are frequently reported as "undetermined serotype" by commercial assays, and a previously validated RT-qPCR covers only the African clade, leaving the divergent Malaysian clade undetected. Using a curated set of 25 complete or near-complete DENV-2/GVI genomes, we identified conserved yet clade-discriminatory regions in the E (African clade) and NS5 (Malaysian clade) genes and designed oligonucleotides in two formats: a dual-target format for grouped detection (all probes FAM-labelled) and a multiplex format for simultaneous differential detection and classification (African probe Cy5, Malaysian probe FAM). Six in vitro-transcribed RNA (ivRNA) standards spanning both clades and a wide temporal range were used for analytical validation. Both formats amplified all six ivRNA standards without cross-amplification, with paired dual–multiplex Ct differences below ± 1.41. For the most recent circulating standards (AF_2020 and MY_2024), analytical sensitivity was comparable between formats (LoD95 ≈ 211.7 and 8.3 copies/reaction, respectively). The MY_2008 standard showed a format-dependent difference (LoD 6.9 vs 64.2 copies/reaction) that remains to be resolved. No cross-reactivity was observed against urban DENV-1–4. Clinical validation using African samples shows comparable results in both formats. This combined strategy extends molecular detection of sylvatic DENV-2 to both the African and Malaysian clades in a single reaction, enabling rapid detection and lineage classification without systematic genome sequencing. The present work is mainly analytical; despite validation on African clade natural isolates and clinical samples expansion to Malaysian Clade counterpart samples is encouraged.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景。西非和亚洲森林传播的登革病毒 2(DENV-2/GVI)基因型在非人灵长类动物和森林蚊虫之间循环,但已有文献报道在塞内加尔和马来西亚出现人类跨物种溢出感染。这些菌株常被商业检测方法误判为"未确定血清型",而一种先前验证的RT-qPCR方法仅能检测非洲分支,无法检测马来西亚分支。利用一组精心挑选的25个完整或近完整的DENV-2/GVI 基因组,我们识别了E基因(非洲分支)和NS5基因(马来西亚分支)中保守但具有分支特异性的区域,并设计了两种格式的寡核苷酸探针:一种用于分组检测(所有探针均标记为FAM),另一种用于同时进行差异检测和分类(非洲探针标记为Cy5,马来西亚探针标记为FAM)。使用覆盖两个分支和广泛时间范围的六种体外转录RNA(ivRNA)标准品进行分析验证。两种格式均能扩增所有六种ivRNA标准品,且无交叉扩增,其配对的双靶-多靶Ct差异均小于±1.41。对于最近流行的菌株标准品(AF_2020和MY_2024),两种格式的分析灵敏度相当(LoD95分别约为211.7和8.3拷贝/反应)。MY_2008标准品显示出格式依赖性的差异(LoD分别为6.9和64.2拷贝/反应),这一差异仍需进一步解决。未观察到与城市型DENV-1至DENV-4之间的交叉反应。使用非洲样本进行的临床验证显示两种格式的结果相当。这种结合策略使单次反应即可实现对非洲和马来西亚分支的西非DENV-2的分子检测扩展,从而实现快速检测和谱系分类,无需系统性基因组测序。本研究主要为分析性研究;尽管已在非洲分支的自然分离株和临床样本上进行了验证,但建议进一步扩展至马来西亚分支的对应样本。
papers.summary_zh: 摘要 背景。西非和亚洲森林传播的登革病毒 2(DENV-2/GVI)基因型在非人灵长类动物和森林蚊虫之间循环,但已有文献报道在塞内加尔和马来西亚出现人类跨物种溢出感染。这些菌株常被商业检测方法误判为"未确定血清型",而一种先前验证的RT-qPCR方法仅能检测非洲分支,无法检测马来西亚分支。利用一组精心挑选的25个完整或近完整的DENV-2/GVI 基因组,我们识别了E基因(非洲分支)和NS5基因(马来西亚分支)中保守但具有分支特异性的区域,并设计了两种格式的寡核苷酸探针:一种用于分组检测(所有探针均标记为FAM),另一种用于同时进行差异检测和分类(非洲探针标记为Cy5,马来西亚探针标记为FAM)。使用覆盖两个分支和广泛时间范围的六种体外转录RNA(ivRNA)标准品进行分析验证。两种格式均能扩增所有六种ivRNA标准品,且无交叉扩增,其配对的双靶-多靶Ct差异均小于±1.41。对于最近流行的菌株标准品(AF_2020和MY_2024),两种格式的分析灵敏度相当(LoD95分别约为211.7和8.3拷贝/反应)。MY_2008标准品显示出格式依赖性的差异(LoD分别为6.9和64.2拷贝/反应),这一差异仍需进一步解决。未观察到与城市型DENV-1至DENV-4之间的交叉反应。使用非洲样本进行的临床验证显示两种格式的结果相当。这种结合策略使单次反应即可实现对非洲和马来西亚分支的西非DENV-2的分子检测扩展,从而实现快速检测和谱系分类,无需系统性基因组测序。本研究主要为分析性研究;尽管已在非洲分支的自然分离株和临床样本上进行了验证,但建议进一步扩展至马来西亚分支的对应样本。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决检测和分类西非和亚洲森林传播的登革病毒 2(DENV-2/GVI)菌株的局限性,这些菌株常被商业检测方法误判为"未确定血清型",且无法被现有的RT-qPCR方法检测到。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及使用一组精心挑选的25个完整或近完整的DENV-2/GVI 基因组开发和验证分子检测策略,并使用覆盖两个分支和广泛时间范围的六种体外转录RNA(ivRNA)标准品进行分析验证。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员识别了DENV-2/GVI的E基因(非洲分支)和NS5基因(马来西亚分支)中保守但具有分支特异性的区域,并分别设计了用于分组检测的双靶格式和用于差异检测与分类的多靶格式寡核苷酸探针。
analysis_zh.main_results: 两种格式均能扩增所有六种ivRNA标准品,且无交叉扩增,其配对的双靶-多靶Ct差异均小于±1.41。对于最近流行的菌株标准品(AF_2020和MY_2024),两种格式的分析灵敏度相当(LoD95分别约为211.7和8.3拷贝/反应)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究提出了一种新颖的结合分子策略,能够在无需系统性基因组测序的情况下,实现对西非DENV-2的快速检测和谱系分类,填补了当前诊断方法的空白。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该策略可以提高西非和马来西亚分支的西非DENV-2在血清学和血清流行学方面的检测能力,有助于更准确地识别和分类循环菌株。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究主要为分析性研究,缺乏大规模临床验证,尽管使用非洲样本在两种格式中均显示出相当的结果。由于验证范围有限,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Computational identification and in vitro evaluation of astragaloside II as an inhibitor of dengue virus NS1-induced endothelial hyperpermeability
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease in which severe cases are marked by leakage of plasma from blood vessels. The secreted nonstructural protein 1 (NS1) of dengue virus damages the endothelial barrier and is a drug target, but no approved antiviral exists. We aimed to identify compounds that target NS1 and to test whether the selected compound, astragaloside II (ASII), counteracts NS1-induced endothelial hyperpermeability. Methodology/Principal findings We built a deep learning model that predicts compound– target binding from chemical fingerprints and protein sequences, and used it to prescreen 177 natural compounds against NS1 of the four dengue virus serotypes. The model outperformed the DeepConv-DTI baseline in recall and F1-score on a BindingDB holdout set and on two independent test sets. ASII was predicted to bind NS1 and was docked onto the NS1 dimer. In human microvascular endothelial cells (HMEC-1), NS1 reduced the relative trans-endothelial electrical resistance to 0.56 (P Conclusions/Significance ASII is a candidate for further study as a modulator of NS1-induced endothelial hyperpermeability. Its mechanism remains unresolved and requires further study. Direct binding to NS1, activity in infected cells and effects in other endothelial models were not tested here, and the computational predictions require experimental confirmation. Author summary Dengue is a viral disease spread by mosquitoes that infects hundreds of millions of people each year. In severe cases, fluid leaks out of the smallest blood vessels, which can cause shock and death. No approved medicine treats the infection itself. A viral protein called NS1, which infected cells release into the blood, helps cause this leakage by damaging the lining of the blood vessels. We therefore looked for a compound that could block the harmful effects of NS1. We trained a computer program to predict which chemicals are likely to stick to a given protein, and we used it to rank 177 natural compounds. We chose one of the best-ranked compounds, astragaloside II, which comes from a plant used in traditional Chinese medicine. In cultures of blood vessel cells, NS1 weakened the cell layer, and astragaloside II prevented this damage without harming the cells. A deep learning model was developed to predict compound–protein interactions and used to screen 177 natural compounds against NS1 of the four dengue virus serotypes. These findings suggest that ASII could be a promising candidate for future studies targeting NS1-induced endothelial hyperpermeability, which is a critical factor in severe dengue disease.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们旨在鉴定针对NS1的化合物,并测试所选化合物astragaloside II(ASII)是否能对抗NS1诱导的内皮高通透性。我们训练了一个计算机程序,预测哪些化学物质可能与特定蛋白质结合,并利用该程序对177种天然化合物进行排名。
elements_zh.methods: 我们构建了一个深度学习模型,该模型通过化学指纹和蛋白质序列预测化合物与靶点的结合,并利用该模型对四种登革病毒血清型的NS1进行预筛选,共筛选了177种天然化合物。我们选择了排名最高的化合物之一astragaloside II,它来源于一种用于传统中医的植物。
elements_zh.main_results: 在血管细胞培养中,NS1削弱了细胞层,而astragaloside II则防止了这种损伤,且不会伤害细胞。该化合物还减少了NS1与细胞表面类似糖的分子的结合,但在保护细胞的剂量下仅表现出较弱的抑制作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该模型在BindingDB保留数据集和两个独立测试集上均优于DeepConv-DTI基线模型,在召回率和F1分数方面表现更优。ASII被预测能够结合NS1,并被对接到NS1二聚体上。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: ASII是进一步研究NS1诱导的内皮高通透性调节剂的候选化合物。我们未在感染细胞或动物中测试该化合物,因此将其视为进一步研究的先导化合物,而非治疗药物。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 此处未测试其直接与NS1结合、在感染细胞中的活性及其他内皮模型中的效应,计算预测结果需要实验验证。

papers.title_zh: 基于计算的登革病毒 NS1诱导的内皮高通透性的抑制剂astragaloside II的鉴定与体外评估
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease in which severe cases are marked by leakage of plasma from blood vessels. The secreted nonstructural protein 1 (NS1) of dengue virus damages the endothelial barrier and is a drug target, but no approved antiviral exists. We aimed to identify compounds that target NS1 and to test whether the selected compound, astragaloside II (ASII), counteracts NS1-induced endothelial hyperpermeability. Methodology/Principal findings We built a deep learning model that predicts compound– target binding from chemical fingerprints and protein sequences, and used it to prescreen 177 natural compounds against NS1 of the four dengue virus serotypes. The model outperformed the DeepConv-DTI baseline in recall and F1-score on a BindingDB holdout set and on two independent test sets. ASII was predicted to bind NS1 and was docked onto the NS1 dimer. In human microvascular endothelial cells (HMEC-1), NS1 reduced the relative trans-endothelial electrical resistance to 0.56 (P Conclusions/Significance ASII is a candidate for further study as a modulator of NS1-induced endothelial hyperpermeability. Its mechanism remains unresolved and requires further study. Direct binding to NS1, activity in infected cells and effects in other endothelial models were not tested here, and the computational predictions require experimental confirmation. Author summary Dengue is a viral disease spread by mosquitoes that infects hundreds of millions of people each year. In severe cases, fluid leaks out of the smallest blood vessels, which can cause shock and death. No approved medicine treats the infection itself. A viral protein called NS1, which infected cells release into the blood, helps cause this leakage by damaging the lining of the blood vessels. We therefore looked for a compound that could block the harmful effects of NS1. We trained a computer program to predict which chemicals are likely to stick to a given protein, and we used it to rank 177 natural compounds. We chose one of the best-ranked compounds, astragaloside II, which comes from a plant used in traditional Chinese medicine. In cultures of blood vessel cells, NS1 weakened the cell layer, and astragaloside II prevented this damage without harming the cells. The compound also reduced the binding of NS1 to a sugar-like molecule on cell surfaces, but only weakly at the doses that protected the cells. We did not test it in infected cells or animals, so we regard it as a lead for further work, not as a treatment.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热是一种由蚊子传播的病毒性疾病,严重病例的特点是血浆从血管中渗漏。登革病毒分泌的非结构蛋白1(NS1)会破坏内皮屏障,是药物靶点,但目前尚无批准的抗病毒药物。我们旨在鉴定针对NS1的化合物,并测试所选化合物astragaloside II(ASII)是否能对抗NS1诱导的内皮高通透性。方法/主要发现 我们构建了一个深度学习模型,该模型通过化学指纹和蛋白质序列预测化合物与靶点的结合,并利用该模型对四种登革病毒血清型的NS1进行预筛选,共筛选了177种天然化合物。该模型在BindingDB保留数据集和两个独立测试集上均优于DeepConv-DTI基线模型,在召回率和F1分数方面表现更优。ASII被预测能够结合NS1,并被对接到NS1二聚体上。在人类微血管内皮细胞(HMEC-1)中,NS1将相对跨内皮电阻力降低至0.56(P < 0.05)。结论/意义 ASII是进一步研究NS1诱导的内皮高通透性调节剂的候选化合物。其作用机制尚未明确,需要进一步研究。此处未测试其直接与NS1结合、在感染细胞中的活性及其他内皮模型中的效应,计算预测结果需要实验验证。作者摘要 登革热是一种由蚊子传播的病毒性疾病,每年感染数百万人。在严重病例中,液体从最小的血管中渗漏,可能导致休克和死亡。目前尚无批准的药物用于治疗感染本身。一种名为NS1的病毒蛋白,被感染细胞释放到血液中,通过破坏血管内壁导致这种渗漏。因此,我们寻找一种能够阻断NS1有害作用的化合物。我们训练了一个计算机程序,预测哪些化学物质可能与特定蛋白质结合,并利用该程序对177种天然化合物进行排名。我们选择了排名最高的化合物之一astragaloside II,它来源于一种用于传统中医的植物。在血管细胞培养中,NS1削弱了细胞层,而astragaloside II则防止了这种损伤,且不会伤害细胞。该化合物还减少了NS1与细胞表面类似糖的分子的结合,但在保护细胞的剂量下仅表现出较弱的抑制作用。我们未在感染细胞或动物中测试该化合物,因此将其视为进一步研究的先导化合物,而非治疗药物。

papers.title: An engineered Zika virus recombinant adenovirus vaccine induces protective immune response in mice
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Zika virus (ZIKV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), and dengue virus (DENV) co-circulate in many countries/territories. Our previous publication reported that the antibodies (Abs) induced by ZIKV infection could exacerbate the mortality of JEV-infected mice, bringing challenges to the development of traditional Zika vaccines. Here, we developed two recombinant adenoviruses (Ad5-ZIKV-E WT and Ad5-ZIKV-E mut ) encoding the ZIKV wild-type E protein and an E protein mutant carrying five amino acid substitutions (replaced by alanine) in the bc loop and fusion loop regions of the E protein, respectively. The levels of JEV-cross-reactive or DENV-cross-reactive Ab responses induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut immunization in mice are lower than those induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT . The level of ZIKV-neutralizing Abs induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut is comparable to that elicited by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT . The ability of Abs induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut to enhance JEV or DENV infections in vitro is attenuated as compared with that induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT . The in vivo protective role of Abs induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut is similar to that induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT . Mice receiving Ad5-ZIKV-E WT -immune mouse sera exhibited antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) post-DENV challenge, whereas passively transferred Ad5-ZIKV-E mut -immune mouse sera did not lead to obvious ADE of DENV infection in recipient mice. Notably, maternally acquired Abs did not enhance the mortality of 2-day-old neonates born to Ad5-ZIKV-E mut -immunized mice post-JEV challenge. These results suggest that optimizing the E protein amino acid sequence of ZIKV could significantly reduce the level of cross-reactive Abs to JEV and DENV, and abrogate the ADE of JEV and DENV infections, providing a promising strategy to develop an effective and safe ZIKV vaccine. IMPORTANCE Zika virus (ZIKV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), and dengue virus (DENV) co-circulate in some countries or territories. The results of preliminary animal experiments and clinical cohort studies support that antibodies induced by ZIKV infection can enhance JEV or DENV infection in vitro and in vivo . Therefore, the ZIKV vaccine encoding the wild-type E protein constructed by conventional methods has the antibody-dependent enhancement risk against JEV and DENV infections. In this study, we obtained an E protein mutant by mutating key amino acids in the bc loop and FL sequences of the ZIKV wild-type E protein to alanine. The recombinant adenovirus vaccine based on this E protein mutant is not only effective but also safer in preventing ZIKV infection in the future.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Zika virus (ZIKV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), and dengue virus (DENV) co-circulate in many countries/territories. The study aimed to address the challenges posed by cross-reactive antibodies in traditional ZIKV vaccines that may exacerbate JEV or DENV infections.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved animal experiments and clinical cohort studies to evaluate the effects of ZIKV-induced antibodies on JEV and DENV infections. The results showed that antibodies from ZIKV infection could enhance these infections in vitro and in vivo.
analysis.methods: The researchers developed two recombinant adenoviruses encoding the ZIKV wild-type E protein and an E protein mutant with five amino acid substitutions in the bc loop and fusion loop regions. They then assessed the immune responses in mice and evaluated the potential for antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) in vitro and in vivo.
analysis.main_results: The levels of JEV-cross-reactive or DENV-cross-reactive antibody responses induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut immunization in mice are lower than those induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT. The ability of antibodies induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut to enhance JEV or DENV infections in vitro is also attenuated compared with those induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The results suggest that optimizing the E protein amino acid sequence of ZIKV could significantly reduce the level of cross-reactive antibodies to JEV and DENV, and abrogate the ADE of JEV and DENV infections, providing a promising strategy to develop an effective and safe ZIKV vaccine.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer insights into vaccine design that could mitigate the risk of antibody-dependent enhancement against JEV and DENV, which is crucial for developing safer ZIKV vaccines with broader cross-protection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on animal experiments and does not include human trials, which limits its direct applicability to public health. However, the evidence is strong and grounded in in vitro and in vivo experimental results.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the development of a ZIKV recombinant adenovirus vaccine and its potential to reduce cross-reactivity with JEV and DENV. The researchers created two vaccine candidates, Ad5-ZIKV-E WT and Ad5-ZIKV-E mut, encoding the wild-type and a modified E protein, respectively. They observed that Ad5-ZIKV-E mut induced lower levels of JEV and DENV cross-reactive antibodies and showed reduced antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) in vitro compared to Ad5-ZIKV-E WT. In vivo, the protective efficacy of Ad5-ZIKV-E mut was similar to that of Ad5-ZIKV-E WT. These results suggest that modifying the E protein sequence could lead to a safer ZIKV vaccine by minimizing ADE risks against related flaviviruses. The study's findings are significant for vaccine development but are limited by the use of animal models rather than human trials.

elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved animal experiments and clinical cohort studies to evaluate the effects of ZIKV-induced antibodies on JEV and DENV infections. The results showed that antibodies from ZIKV infection could enhance these infections in vitro and in vivo.
elements_en.methods: The researchers developed two recombinant adenoviruses encoding the ZIKV wild-type E protein and an E protein mutant with five amino acid substitutions in the bc loop and fusion loop regions. They then assessed the immune responses in mice and evaluated the potential for antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) in vitro and in vivo.
elements_en.main_results: The levels of JEV-cross-reactive or DENV-cross-reactive antibody responses induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut immunization in mice are lower than those induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT. The ability of antibodies induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut to enhance JEV or DENV infections in vitro is also attenuated compared with those induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The results suggest that optimizing the E protein amino acid sequence of ZIKV could significantly reduce the level of cross-reactive antibodies to JEV and DENV, and abrogate the ADE of JEV and DENV infections, providing a promising strategy to develop an effective and safe ZIKV vaccine.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer insights into vaccine design that could mitigate the risk of antibody-dependent enhancement against JEV and DENV, which is crucial for developing safer ZIKV vaccines with broader cross-protection.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on animal experiments and does not include human trials, which limits its direct applicability to public health. However, the evidence is strong and grounded in in vitro and in vivo experimental results.

elements_zh.main_results: Ad5-ZIKV-E mut免疫小鼠诱导的JEV交叉反应性或DENV交叉反应性抗体水平低于Ad5-ZIKV-E WT免疫小鼠。Ad5-ZIKV-E mut诱导的抗体在体外增强JEV或DENV感染的能力也较Ad5-ZIKV-E WT有所减弱。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些结果表明,优化寨卡病毒E蛋白的氨基酸序列可以显著降低对JEV和DENV的交叉反应性抗体水平,并消除JEV和DENV感染的ADE风险,为开发一种有效且安全的寨卡病毒疫苗提供了有前景的策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为疫苗的设计提供了见解,有助于降低针对JEV和DENV的抗体依赖性增强风险,这对于开发更安全、具有更广泛交叉保护能力的寨卡病毒疫苗至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于动物实验,未包括人体试验,这限制了其对公共卫生的直接适用性。然而,证据是强有力的,并基于体外和体内的实验结果。

papers.title_zh: 一种工程改造的寨卡病毒重组腺病毒疫苗在小鼠中诱导保护性免疫应答
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Zika virus (ZIKV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), and dengue virus (DENV) co-circulate in many countries/territories. Our previous publication reported that the antibodies (Abs) induced by ZIKV infection could exacerbate the mortality of JEV-infected mice, bringing challenges to the development of traditional Zika vaccines. Here, we developed two recombinant adenoviruses (Ad5-ZIKV-E WT and Ad5-ZIKV-E mut ) encoding the ZIKV wild-type E protein and an E protein mutant carrying five amino acid substitutions (replaced by alanine) in the bc loop and fusion loop regions of the E protein, respectively. The levels of JEV-cross-reactive or DENV-cross-reactive Ab responses induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut immunization in mice are lower than those induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT . The level of ZIKV-neutralizing Abs induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut is comparable to that elicited by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT . The ability of Abs induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut to enhance JEV or DENV infections in vitro is attenuated as compared with that induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT . The in vivo protective role of Abs induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E mut is similar to that induced by Ad5-ZIKV-E WT . Mice receiving Ad5-ZIKV-E WT -immune mouse sera exhibited antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) post-DENV challenge, whereas passively transferred Ad5-ZIKV-E mut -immune mouse sera did not lead to obvious ADE of DENV infection in recipient mice. Notably, maternally acquired Abs did not enhance the mortality of 2-day-old neonates born to Ad5-ZIKV-E mut -immunized mice post-JEV challenge. These results suggest that optimizing the E protein amino acid sequence of ZIKV could significantly reduce the level of cross-reactive Abs to JEV and DENV, and abrogate the ADE of JEV and DENV infections, providing a promising strategy to develop an effective and safe ZIKV vaccine. IMPORTANCE Zika virus (ZIKV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), and dengue virus (DENV) co-circulate in some countries or territories. The results of preliminary animal experiments and clinical cohort studies support that antibodies induced by ZIKV infection can enhance JEV or DENV infection in vitro and in vivo . Therefore, the ZIKV vaccine encoding the wild-type E protein constructed by conventional methods has the antibody-dependent enhancement risk against JEV and DENV infections. In this study, we obtained an E protein mutant by mutating key amino acids in the bc loop and FL sequences of the ZIKV wild-type E protein to alanine. The recombinant adenovirus vaccine based on this E protein mutant is not only effective but also safer in preventing ZIKV infection in the future.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 寨卡病毒(ZIKV)、日本脑炎病毒(JEV)和登革病毒(DENV)在许多国家/地区共存。我们之前的研究报告指出,寨卡病毒感染诱导的抗体(Abs)可能会加剧JEV感染小鼠的死亡率,给传统寨卡病毒疫苗的研发带来挑战。在此,我们开发了两种重组腺病毒(Ad5-ZIKV-E WT和Ad5-ZIKV-E mut),分别编码寨卡病毒野生型E蛋白和一个在E蛋白的bc环和融合环区域分别替换五个氨基酸为丙氨酸的E蛋白突变体。Ad5-ZIKV-E mut免疫小鼠诱导的JEV交叉反应性或DENV交叉反应性抗体水平低于Ad5-ZIKV-E WT免疫小鼠。Ad5-ZIKV-E mut诱导的寨卡病毒中和抗体水平与Ad5-ZIKV-E WT诱导的水平相当。Ad5-ZIKV-E mut诱导的抗体增强JEV或DENV感染的能力在体外较Ad5-ZIKV-E WT有所减弱。Ad5-ZIKV-E mut诱导的抗体在体内的保护作用与Ad5-ZIKV-E WT诱导的相似。接受Ad5-ZIKV-E WT免疫小鼠血清的小鼠在DENV挑战后表现出抗体依赖性增强(ADE),而被动转移Ad5-ZIKV-E mut免疫小鼠血清则未在受体小鼠中导致明显的DENV感染ADE。值得注意的是,母源性获得的抗体在Ad5-ZIKV-E mut免疫小鼠所生的2日龄新生小鼠接受JEV挑战后,并未增强其死亡率。这些结果表明,优化寨卡病毒E蛋白的氨基酸序列可以显著降低对JEV和DENV的交叉反应性抗体水平,并消除JEV和DENV感染的ADE风险,为开发一种有效且安全的寨卡病毒疫苗提供了有前景的策略。重要性 寨卡病毒(ZIKV)、日本脑炎病毒(JEV)和登革病毒(DENV)在一些国家或地区共存。初步动物实验和临床队列研究研究的结果支持了寨卡病毒感染诱导的抗体可能在体外和体内增强JEV或DENV感染的观点。因此,通过传统方法构建的编码野生型E蛋白的寨卡病毒疫苗存在针对JEV和DENV感染的抗体依赖性增强风险。在本研究中,我们通过将ZIKV野生型E蛋白的bc环和FL序列中的关键氨基酸替换为丙氨酸,获得了一种E蛋白突变体。基于这种E蛋白突变体的重组腺病毒疫苗不仅在预防寨卡病毒感染方面有效,而且更加安全。

papers.title: Targeting CLK1 by CRISPR tools and pharmacological inhibition modulates the innate immune response and dengue virus replication.
papers.abstract: Alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism known to be altered upon viral infection. These alterations can arise both from direct viral interference with the splicing machinery and from cellular responses such as activation of innate immunity. Here, we investigated splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells, the latter serving as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation. Among the common events, we identified an increased production of non-coding mRNA isoforms from the CLK1 gene, which gives rise to a kinase that phosphorylates splicing factors including SR proteins and spliceosomal components. Consistent with this finding, IFN treatment led to a reduction in CLK1 protein levels. Using stable cell lines with CRISPR/dCas9-mediated modulation of CLK1 expression, we found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its overexpression attenuated it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with the pharmacological inhibitor TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. Altogether, these results identify CLK1 as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression and suggest that its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses and become a target for therapeutic strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨病毒感染和干扰素 治疗 如何影响剪接变化,因为选择性剪接是病毒感染过程中被改变的关键调控机制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用培养的细胞来研究 登革病毒(登革病毒)感染和干扰素(IFN) 治疗 对剪接变化的影响,其中 IFN 治疗 作为病毒独立的先天免疫激活模型。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用 CRISPR/dCas9 工具调节 CLK1 表达,并使用药物抑制剂评估 CLK1 激酶活性对 免疫应答 基因和登革病毒复制的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,在登革病毒感染和 IFN 治疗 激活过程中,CLK1 基因表达均增加,但 IFN 治疗 导致 CLK1 蛋白水平下降。沉默 CLK1 增强了 免疫应答 基因的诱导,而其过表达则抑制了该诱导。使用 TG003 抑制 CLK1 激酶活性进一步增强了干扰素诱导的基因表达,并减少了登革病毒的复制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明 CLK1 在干扰素刺激基因表达中起负调控作用,其抑制可能有助于增强 抗病毒药物 防御能力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为针对 CLK1 的潜在治疗策略提供了见解,以增强 抗病毒药物 对登革病毒的防御能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于培养细胞,可能无法完全代表体内情况,且证据基于实验性调节而非直接观察病毒在人体中的行为。证据强度为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 选择性剪接是已知在病毒感染时发生改变的关键调节机制。这些改变可能来自病毒对剪接机制的直接干扰,也可能来自细胞反应,例如先天免疫的激活。在这里,我们研究了培养细胞中 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染和干扰素 (IFN) 治疗 之间共享的剪接变化,后者作为病毒依赖性先天免疫激活的模型。在常见事件中,我们发现 CLK1 基因非编码 mRNA 亚型的产量增加,从而产生一种磷酸化剪接因子(包括 SR 蛋白和剪接体成分)的激酶。与这一发现一致,IFN 治疗 导致 CLK1 蛋白水平降低。使用具有 CRISPR/dCas9 介导的 CLK1 表达调节的稳定细胞系,我们发现沉默 CLK1 增强了 免疫应答 基因的诱导,而其过度表达则减弱了这种诱导。用药理学抑制剂 TG003 抑制 CLK1 激酶活性,进一步增强 IFN 诱导的基因表达并减少 DENV 复制。总而言之,这些结果确定 CLK1 是 IFN 刺激的基因表达的前病毒负调节因子,并表明其抑制可以增强 抗病毒药物 防御并成为治疗策略的目标。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用培养的细胞来研究 登革病毒(登革病毒)感染和干扰素(IFN) 治疗 对剪接变化的影响,其中 IFN 治疗 作为病毒独立的先天免疫激活模型。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员使用 CRISPR/dCas9 工具调节 CLK1 表达,并使用药物抑制剂评估 CLK1 激酶活性对 免疫应答 基因和登革病毒复制的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究发现,在登革病毒感染和 IFN 治疗 激活过程中,CLK1 基因表达均增加,但 IFN 治疗 导致 CLK1 蛋白水平下降。沉默 CLK1 增强了 免疫应答 基因的诱导,而其过表达则抑制了该诱导。使用 TG003 抑制 CLK1 激酶活性进一步增强了干扰素诱导的基因表达,并减少了登革病毒的复制。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明 CLK1 在干扰素刺激基因表达中起负调控作用,其抑制可能有助于增强 抗病毒药物 防御能力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为针对 CLK1 的潜在治疗策略提供了见解,以增强 抗病毒药物 对登革病毒的防御能力。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于培养细胞,可能无法完全代表体内情况,且证据基于实验性调节而非直接观察病毒在人体中的行为。证据强度为中等。

papers.title: Serum untargeted metabolomics reveals infection-associated metabolic alterations in chikungunya, dengue, and influenza A virus infections.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), dengue virus (DENV), and influenza A virus (IAV) infections may present with overlapping febrile symptoms during the early clinical phase. Routine laboratory tests provide useful clinical information but do not fully capture the circulating metabolic alterations associated with different viral infections. This study aimed to characterize serum metabolic profiles in CHIKV, DENV, and IAV infections using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS)-based untargeted metabolomics. METHODS: In this comparative cross-sectional study, serum samples from patients with CHIKV, DENV, or IAV infection and healthy controls were analyzed using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS)-based untargeted metabolomics. Data were acquired in both positive and negative electrospray ionization modes, and the datasets were processed to characterize infection-associated metabolic alterations. Quality-control assessment, principal component analysis, orthogonal partial least-squares discriminant analysis, differential metabolite screening with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway classification, and receiver operating characteristic analysis were performed. RESULTS: Thousands of metabolic features were detected across positive and negative ion mode datasets, and annotated features were retained for downstream comparative analyses. Principal component analysis revealed group-dependent metabolic clustering with partial overlap between healthy controls and viral infection groups. Compared with healthy controls, 319, 300, and 295 differential metabolic features were identified in the CHIKV, DENV, and IAV groups, respectively, in positive ion mode, whereas 52, 40, and 33 differential features were identified in negative ion mode. Downregulated features predominated in the positive-ion comparisons, while the direction of metabolic alterations varied across groups in negative ion mode. KEGG pathway classification showed that differential metabolites were mapped to several major categories, including lipid metabolism, amino acid metabolism, metabolism of cofactors and vitamins, xenobiotics biodegradation and metabolism, and chemical structure transformation maps. Exploratory receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis within the discovery cohort identified multiple metabolites with high discriminatory performance for distinguishing viral infection groups from healthy controls, although these findings were not independently validated. Additional mode-specific analyses further characterized shared differential metabolic features, their directional changes, and the distribution of candidate metabolites with high AUC values. CONCLUSIONS: CHIKV, DENV, and IAV infections were associated with broad serum metabolic alterations compared with healthy controls. The CHIKV-versus-control comparison yielded the largest number of altered metabolic features in the current dataset, although this observation should be interpreted cautiously because of unequal sampling proportions and the absence of direct comparisons between infection groups. Given the relatively small sample size, single-center and single-outbreak design, and lack of an independent validation cohort, the candidate metabolites identified in this study should be regarded as exploratory and require validation in larger independent cohorts and targeted metabolomic assays.

analysis.study_design_and_population: In this comparative cross-sectional study, serum samples from patients with CHIKV, DENV, or IAV infection and healthy controls were analyzed using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS)-based untargeted metabolomics.
analysis.methods: Data were acquired in both positive and negative electrospray ionization modes, and the datasets were processed to characterize infection-associated metabolic alterations. Quality-control assessment, principal component analysis, orthogonal partial least-squares discriminant analysis, differential metabolite screening with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway classification, and receiver operating characteristic analysis were performed.
analysis.main_results: Thousands of metabolic features were detected across positive and negative ion mode datasets, and annotated features were retained for downstream comparative analyses. Principal component analysis revealed group-dependent metabolic clustering with partial overlap between healthy controls and viral infection groups. Compared with healthy controls, 319, 300, and 295 differential metabolic features were identified in the CHIKV, DENV, and IAV groups, respectively, in positive ion mode, whereas 52, 40, and 33 differential features were identified in negative ion mode.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: CHIKV, DENV, and IAV infections were associated with broad serum metabolic alterations compared with healthy controls. The CHIKV-versus-control comparison yielded the largest number of altered metabolic features in the current dataset, although this observation should be interpreted cautiously because of unequal sampling proportions and the absence of direct comparisons between infection groups.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the development of more accurate diagnostic tools and provide insights into the metabolic mechanisms underlying viral infections, which could aid in targeted therapeutic strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Given the relatively small sample size, single-center and single-outbreak design, and lack of an independent validation cohort, the candidate metabolites identified in this study should be regarded as exploratory and require validation in larger independent cohorts and targeted metabolomic assays.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to characterize serum metabolic profiles in chikungunya, dengue, and influenza A virus infections using untargeted metabolomics. It revealed broad metabolic alterations associated with these infections compared to healthy controls, with the chikungunya-versus-control comparison showing the largest number of altered features. However, the study's limitations include a small sample size, single-center design, and lack of independent validation, which suggest that the findings are exploratory and require further investigation. The results may contribute to the development of more precise diagnostic tools and a deeper understanding of the metabolic changes linked to viral infections.

elements_zh.main_results: Thousands of metabolic features were detected across positive and negative ion mode datasets, and annotated features were retained for downstream comparative analyses. Principal component analysis revealed group-dependent metabolic clustering with partial overlap between healthy controls and viral infection groups. Compared with healthy controls, 319, 300, and 295 differential metabolic features were identified in the CHIKV, DENV, and IAV groups, respectively, in positive ion mode, whereas 52, 40, and 33 differential features were identified in negative ion mode.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: CHIKV、DENV和IAV感染与健康对照相比,与广泛的血清代谢改变相关。在当前数据集中,CHIKV与对照组的比较产生了最多的代谢改变特征,但这一观察结果应谨慎解读,因为样本量比例不均且缺乏感染组之间的直接比较。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于开发更准确的诊断工具,并提供关于病毒感染代谢机制的见解,从而有助于制定针对性的治疗策略。

papers.title_zh: 血清非靶向代谢组学揭示寨卡病毒、登革病毒和流感A病毒感染期间感染相关的代谢改变。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), dengue virus (DENV), and influenza A virus (IAV) infections may present with overlapping febrile symptoms during the early clinical phase. Routine laboratory tests provide useful clinical information but do not fully capture the circulating metabolic alterations associated with different viral infections. This study aimed to characterize serum metabolic profiles in CHIKV, DENV, and IAV infections using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS)-based untargeted metabolomics. METHODS: In this comparative cross-sectional study, serum samples from patients with CHIKV, DENV, or IAV infection and healthy controls were analyzed using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS)-based untargeted metabolomics. Data were acquired in both positive and negative electrospray ionization modes, and the datasets were processed to characterize infection-associated metabolic alterations. Quality-control assessment, principal component analysis, orthogonal partial least-squares discriminant analysis, differential metabolite screening with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway classification, and receiver operating characteristic analysis were performed. RESULTS: Thousands of metabolic features were detected across positive and negative ion mode datasets, and annotated features were retained for downstream comparative analyses. Principal component analysis revealed group-dependent metabolic clustering with partial overlap between healthy controls and viral infection groups. Compared with healthy controls, 319, 300, and 295 differential metabolic features were identified in the CHIKV, DENV, and IAV groups, respectively, in positive ion mode, whereas 52, 40, and 33 differential features were identified in negative ion mode. Downregulated features predominated in the positive-ion comparisons, while the direction of metabolic alterations varied across groups in negative ion mode. KEGG pathway classification showed that differential metabolites were mapped to several major categories, including lipid metabolism, amino acid metabolism, metabolism of cofactors and vitamins, xenobiotics biodegradation and metabolism, and chemical structure transformation maps. Exploratory receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis within the discovery cohort identified multiple metabolites with high discriminatory performance for distinguishing viral infection groups from healthy controls, although these findings were not independently validated. Additional mode-specific analyses further characterized shared differential metabolic features, their directional changes, and the distribution of candidate metabolites with high AUC values. CONCLUSIONS: CHIKV, DENV, and IAV infections were associated with broad serum metabolic alterations compared with healthy controls. The CHIKV-versus-control comparison yielded the largest number of altered metabolic features in the current dataset, although this observation should be interpreted cautiously because of unequal sampling proportions and the absence of direct comparisons between infection groups. Given the relatively small sample size, single-center and single-outbreak design, and lack of an independent validation cohort, the candidate metabolites identified in this study should be regarded as exploratory and require validation in larger independent cohorts and targeted metabolomic assays.

papers.title: Spatial and Spatiotemporal Clustering of Dengue in Jambi Municipality, Indonesia, 2010–2024
papers.abstract: Background & objectives: Dengue is a public health problem in Indonesia, particularly in urbanising cities where transmission patterns are spatially heterogeneous and seasonally dynamic. This study aimed to identify the spatial and spatiotemporal clusters of dengue cases in Jambi Municipality, Indonesia. A retrospective ecological study was conducted using dengue surveillance data aggregated across 62 urban villages. Methods: Monthly counts of clinically diagnosed dengue cases reported through routine surveillance between 1 January 2010 and 31 December 2024 were obtained from the Jambi Municipality Health Office. Population data were obtained from the Central Bureau of Statistics and cases were analysed at the urban-village level to support local surveillance. Retrospective spatial and space-time cluster analyses were carried out using SaTScan TM with a discrete Poisson model. Monte Carlo hypothesis testing was used to assess statistical significance, and the clusters were visualised with Quantum GIS. Results: A total of 7,099 clinically diagnosed dengue cases were reported. Purely spatial and space-time analyses identified 24 and 39 significant clusters, respectively. Recurrent high-risk clusters were concentrated mainly in the central and southern parts of the municipality, although their locations varied by year. Among the 39 space-time clusters, 37 were in a minimum of one rainy-season month (October-April), and the other two secondary clusters were limited to the dry season (August 2011 and June 2023. Interpretation & conclusion: Dengue showed recurrent small-area clustering and significant overlap with rainy-season months over 15 years, suggesting the need for fine-scale surveillance and spatially targeted vector control.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是印度尼西亚的公共卫生问题,特别是在城市化进程较快的城市中,登革热的传播模式在空间上具有异质性且季节性动态变化。本研究旨在识别印度尼西亚占米市登革热病例的空间和时空聚集区域。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 采用回顾性生态学研究方法,使用了覆盖62个城区村庄的登革热传播模式数据。人口数据来源于中央统计局,病例分析在城区村庄层面进行以支持本地传播模式。采用SaTScan TM软件,使用离散泊松模型进行回顾性空间和时空聚集分析。
elements_zh.methods: 从占米市卫生办公室获取了2010年1月1日至2024年12月31日期间通过常规传播模式报告的每月临床诊断登革热病例数。通过蒙特卡洛假设检验评估统计显著性,并使用Quantum GIS对聚集区域进行可视化。
elements_zh.main_results: 共报告了7,099例临床诊断的登革热病例。纯空间分析和时空分析分别识别出24个和39个显著聚集区域。反复出现的高风险聚集区域主要集中在占米市的中部和南部,尽管其位置每年有所不同。在39个时空聚集区域中,有37个出现在至少一个月的雨季(10月至4月),另外两个次要聚集区域则局限于旱季(2011年8月和2023年6月)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在15年间,登革热表现出反复的小区域聚集,并与雨季月份有显著重叠,这表明需要进行精细尺度的传播模式监测和空间针对性的传播模式控制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要进行精细尺度的传播模式监测和空间针对性的传播模式控制,以应对印度尼西亚占米市登革热的传播模式。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于其回顾性设计和对聚合传播模式数据的依赖,这可能无法捕捉个体层面的变化。由于基于生态学数据和统计分析,证据强度中等。

papers.title: TRIM5α, TRIM56 and TRIM69 differentially regulate dengue virus 2 infection through selective NS2B3-mediated antagonism
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) is a major mosquito-borne human pathogen. Understanding the mechanisms of cellular resistance to the infection is vital to develop novel therapeutic tools. Tripartite motif (TRIM) proteins contribute to antiviral innate immunity through direct restriction of viral replication and regulation of antiviral signaling, but current knowledge on DENV targeting by TRIM proteins remains preliminary. Previously, TRIM56 was found to inhibit DENV, whereas reports on whether TRIM69 is a DENV restriction factor are conflicting. Surprisingly, the broad-spectrum viral restriction factor TRIM5α was proposed to restrict tick-borne but not mosquito-borne flaviviruses. Here, we investigated the effects of TRIM5α, TRIM56, and TRIM69 on DENV serotype 2 (DENV2) infection. Overexpression experiments showed that TRIM5α and TRIM56 restrict DENV2, whereas TRIM69 enhances it. Consistently, CRISPR/Cas9-mediated loss-of-function showed that knocking out TRIM5α or TRIM56 increases infection, while TRIM69 knockout decreases it. Restriction correlated with reduced viral RNA and viral protein levels in TRIM5α- and TRIM56-expressing cells. Virus-free experiments showed that TRIM56 downregulates the DENV2 protease complex NS2B3 levels. Reciprocally, DENV2 NS2B3 reduced TRIM56 and TRIM69 abundance independently of protease activity. RING domain-mutated TRIM56 retained partial antiviral activity and the ability to reduce NS2B3 levels, and TRIM56-NS2B3 reciprocal downmodulation effects were not counteracted by proteasomal or lysosomal inhibition. Together, these findings establish TRIM5α as a DENV2 restriction factor, reveal TRIM69 as a positive factor in DENV2 infection, suggest that TRIM5? and TRIM56 inhibit DENV2 through distinct mechanisms, and hint at proteasome-independent TRIM56-NS2B3 reciprocal downmodulation.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒(登革病毒,DENV)是一种主要的蚊媒人类病原体。理解细胞对感染的抵抗机制对于开发新的治疗工具至关重要。三结构域(TRIM)蛋白通过直接限制病毒复制和调控抗病毒药物信号通路参与抗病毒药物先天免疫,但目前关于TRIM蛋白对DENV靶向作用的知识仍处于初步阶段。此前发现TRIM56能够抑制DENV,但关于TRIM69是否为DENV限制因子的报道存在矛盾。令人惊讶的是,广谱病毒限制因子TRIM5α被提出可限制蜱媒但非蚊媒黄病毒。在此,我们研究了TRIM5α、TRIM56和TRIM69对登革病毒2型(DENV2)感染的影响。过表达实验表明TRIM5α和TRIM56限制DENV2感染,而TRIM69则增强感染。一致地,CRISPR/Cas9介导的失能实验显示敲除TRIM5α或TRIM56会增加感染,而敲除TRIM69则会减少感染。限制作用与TRIM5α和TRIM56表达细胞中病毒RNA和病毒蛋白水平的降低相关。病毒无感染实验表明TRIM56可下调DENV2蛋白酶复合物NS2B3的水平。相反,DENV2 NS2B3可独立于蛋白酶活性降低TRIM56和TRIM69的丰度。RING结构域突变的TRIM56保留了部分抗病毒药物活性,并且仍能降低NS2B3水平,TRIM56-NS2B3的相互下调效应并未被蛋白酶体或溶酶体抑制所抵消。综上所述,这些发现确立了TRIM5α作为DENV2的限制因子,揭示了TRIM69在DENV2感染中的正向作用,表明TRIM5α和TRIM56通过不同的机制抑制DENV2,并提示TRIM56-NS2B3的相互下调可能不依赖于蛋白酶体。

papers.title: Mutation of Dengue Virus Envelope Protein and Mechanism of Cross-Host Transmission
papers.abstract: Dengue virus spreads worldwide. Mosquitoes of the Aedes genus pass it to humans. The virus poses big risks to global public health. Its envelope protein, E protein, controls three key viral behaviors. It lets viruses recognize host cells, fuse cell membranes and live through changing environments. Most adaptive non-synonymous mutations appear on the gene that makes E protein. These amino acid changes reshape the protein’s 3D structure. This change lets dengue jump across different host species. This paper sorts out E protein structures and sites where mutations often happen. It explains how single amino acid changes affect virus heat resistance, receptor binding speed and intracellular replication. Mutated E proteins help viruses escape mosquito immune defenses. They also help viruses survive stress inside mammalian cells. This paper builds a full molecular path to explain how dengue shifts between mosquitoes and people. Current research has clear limits. Few studies measure how multiple mutations work together. Lab cell models cannot copy real infection environments. Long-term tracking of wild virus strains is rare. This work improves theories about dengue’s evolution in two hosts. It picks out key adaptive mutation sites. It offers theory support for epidemic early warning, broad-spectrum vaccine design and new antiviral drug research.
papers.journal: International Journal of Biology and Life Sciences

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to understand how mutations in the Dengue virus envelope protein contribute to its ability to transmit across different hosts. Dengue virus spreads worldwide, posing significant public health risks.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on the molecular mechanisms of Dengue virus transmission between mosquitoes and humans, analyzing its envelope protein and mutation patterns in both hosts.
analysis.methods: The research involved sorting out E protein structures and identifying mutation sites through molecular analysis, explaining how single amino acid changes affect heat resistance, receptor binding speed and intracellular replication.
analysis.main_results: Most adaptive non-synonymous mutations occur on the gene that encodes the E protein, and these amino acid changes reshape the protein’s 3D structure, enabling the virus to jump across different host species.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as a molecular pathway explaining how Dengue virus shifts between mosquitoes and humans, offering new insights into its cross-host transmission mechanism.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform epidemic early warning systems, guide the design of broad-spectrum vaccines and support the development of new antiviral drugs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study has limitations, including the lack of long-term tracking of wild virus strains and the inability of lab cell models to fully replicate real infection environments. The evidence is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores how mutations in the Dengue virus envelope protein enable its cross-host transmission. The research identifies key mutation sites and explains their impact on heat resistance, receptor binding and intracellular replication. These findings contribute to understanding the molecular mechanisms of Dengue virus adaptation between mosquitoes and humans, offering insights for vaccine and drug development. However, the study has limitations, such as the absence of long-term tracking of wild strains and the use of lab models that cannot fully mimic real infection environments. The evidence is moderate, highlighting the need for further research to validate these mechanisms in natural settings.

papers.title: Global disparities in dengue, climate, and extreme weather research: a bibliometric analysis of alignment with disease burden and climate-driven vector suitability
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue is a climate-sensitive vector-borne disease that imposes a substantial public health burden in tropical and subtropical regions. Temperature, rainfall, and extreme weather can affect mosquito ecology, human exposure, and the environmental suitability for transmission. This study characterized the global research landscape of dengue and extreme weather and examined whether country-level research output corresponded to dengue burden and climate-driven vector suitability. METHODS: The Web of Science Core Collection was searched on 22 May 2026. Publication trends, collaboration networks, journals, authors, co-cited references, citation bursts, keyword patterns, and thematic evolution were examined using CiteSpace, VOSviewer, and the bibliometrix R package. Country-level publication output was linked to estimates from the Global Burden of Disease 2023 dataset, the socio-demographic index for 2021, and mean index-p values for 1990-2022. Associations between publication output and dengue burden were assessed using Spearman's rank correlation among countries classified as dengue-endemic. RESULTS: A total of 290 publications from 2008 to 2026 met the eligibility criteria. Annual publication output increased overall and remained comparatively high after 2020. The United States contributed the largest number of publications, followed by China, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Brazil. The literature connected tropical medicine and infectious disease epidemiology with environmental health, climate science, vector ecology, modeling, and public health. Major themes included climate change, temperature, rainfall, the El Niño-Southern Oscillation, extreme weather, Aedes vectors, transmission modeling, risk prediction, and early warning. Among 80 countries classified as dengue-endemic, publication output was positively correlated with the age-standardized incidence rate (ASIR) in 2023 (Spearman's ρ = 0.32, P = 0.004, n = 80) and the disability-adjusted life-year (DALY) rate in 2023 (ρ = 0.36, P < 0.001, n = 80). In contrast, its association with the estimated annual percentage change (EAPC) in ASIR from 1990 to 2023 was not statistically significant (ρ = 0.20, P = 0.070, n = 80). Several dengue-endemic countries with comparatively high disease burden or long-term climate-driven vector suitability had no eligible Web of Science-indexed publications in the present dataset. CONCLUSIONS: Research on dengue and extreme weather has expanded, and publication output showed modest positive associations with contemporary dengue burden among dengue-endemic countries. However, research output was not significantly associated with the long-term trend in dengue incidence, and substantial geographic disparities remained. The separate assessment of burden, research output, and climate-driven vector suitability identified geographic areas that may warrant closer consideration when research capacity, surveillance support, and equitable international partnerships are developed.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是一种气候敏感的媒介传播疾病,在热带和亚热带地区对公共卫生构成重大负担。温度、降雨和极端天气会影响蚊虫生态、人类暴露以及传播的环境适宜性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究描述了登革热和极端天气的全球研究格局,并检查了国家层面的研究产出是否与登革热负担和气候驱动的媒介适宜性相一致。于2026年5月22日搜索了Web of Science核心数据库。
elements_zh.methods: 使用CiteSpace、VOSviewer和bibliometrix R包分析出版趋势、合作网络、期刊、作者、共同引用参考文献、引用爆发、关键词模式和主题进化。国家层面的出版产出与2023年全球疾病负担数据集、2021年社会人口指数以及1990-2022年平均指数-p值进行了关联。使用Spearman等级相关分析评估出版产出与登革热负担之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 2008年至2026年间共有290篇文献符合纳入标准。总体年度出版产出呈上升趋势,并且在2020年后相对较高。美国贡献了最多的文献,其次是中华人民共和国、英国、澳大利亚和巴西。在当前数据集中,一些登革热流行地区国家尽管疾病负担较高或长期气候驱动的媒介适宜性较高,但没有符合纳入标准的Web of Science索引文献。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 登革热与极端天气的研究已有所扩展,出版产出与登革热流行地区的当前疾病负担显示出适度的正相关。然而,研究产出与登革热发病率的长期趋势无显著关联,且仍存在显著的地理差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 文献将热带医学和传染病流行病学与环境健康、气候科学、媒介生态、建模和公共卫生联系起来。对疾病负担、研究产出和气候驱动的媒介适宜性进行单独评估,识别了可能需要在发展研究能力、监测支持和公平的国际合作伙伴关系时进一步关注的地理区域。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告设计局限性、偏倚、混杂因素、样本量、控制措施、可推广性或仅摘要的证据。使用Spearman等级相关分析评估出版产出与登革热负担之间的关联,这可能无法捕捉复杂的关系。证据强度为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革热是一种气候敏感的媒介传播疾病,在热带和亚热带地区对公共卫生构成重大负担。温度、降雨和极端天气会影响蚊虫生态、人类暴露以及传播的环境适宜性。本研究描述了登革热和极端天气的全球研究格局,并检查了国家层面的研究产出是否与登革热负担和气候驱动的媒介适宜性相一致。方法:于2026年5月22日搜索Web of Science核心数据库。使用CiteSpace、VOSviewer和bibliometrix R包分析出版趋势、合作网络、期刊、作者、共同引用参考文献、引用爆发、关键词模式和主题进化。国家层面的出版产出与2023年全球疾病负担数据集、2021年社会人口指数以及1990-2022年平均指数-p值进行了关联。使用Spearman等级相关分析评估出版产出与登革热负担之间的关联。结果:2008年至2026年间共有290篇文献符合纳入标准。总体年度出版产出呈上升趋势,并且在2020年后相对较高。美国贡献了最多的文献,其次是中华人民共和国、英国、澳大利亚和巴西。文献将热带医学和传染病流行病学与环境健康、气候科学、媒介生态、建模和公共卫生联系起来。主要主题包括气候变化、温度、降雨、厄尔尼诺-南方涛动、极端天气、Aedes 媒介、传播建模、风险预测和早期预警。在80个被归类为登革热流行地区的国家中,出版产出与2023年的年龄标准化发病率率(ASIR)呈正相关(Spearman's ρ = 0.32,P = 0.004,n = 80),与2023年的伤残调整生命年(DALY)率呈正相关(ρ = 0.36,P < 0.001,n = 80)。相比之下,其与1990年至2023年ASIR的估计年百分比变化(EAPC)之间的关联并不具有统计学意义(ρ = 0.20,P = 0.070,n = 80)。在当前数据集中,一些登革热流行地区国家尽管疾病负担较高或长期气候驱动的媒介适宜性较高,但没有符合纳入标准的Web of Science索引文献。结论:登革热与极端天气的研究已有所扩展,出版产出与登革热流行地区的当前疾病负担显示出适度的正相关。然而,研究产出与登革热发病率的长期趋势无显著关联,且仍存在显著的地理差异。对疾病负担、研究产出和气候驱动的媒介适宜性进行单独评估,识别了可能需要在发展研究能力、监测支持和公平的国际合作伙伴关系时进一步关注的地理区域。局限性与证据强度:提供的证据未报告设计局限性、偏倚、混杂因素、样本量、控制措施、可推广性或仅摘要的证据。使用Spearman等级相关分析评估出版产出与登革热负担之间的关联,这可能无法捕捉复杂的关系。证据强度为中等。

papers.title: Modelling modified insect release interventions for malaria control: a scoping review and thematic comparison with dengue.
papers.abstract: Wolbachia is a promising new intervention for malaria control. While modelling has supported Wolbachia deployment for dengue control, its application in Anopheles is still emerging. We systematically reviewed dynamic transmission models of Wolbachia-based modified insect releases for malaria using PubMed and Embase. Evidence was compared primarily with Wolbachia-based dengue models from a parallel Wolbachia-Aedes aegypti scoping review and secondarily with gene drive-based Anopheles models identified through a separate systematic search. Across 110 included studies, three major gaps were identified. First, context-dependent fitness effects are rarely incorporated, with many models assuming high maternal transmission (MT) and cytoplasmic incompatibility (CI), limiting assessment of how environmental variability influences persistence. Second, spatial heterogeneity is infrequently modelled despite evidence that mosquito movement shapes Wolbachia spread. Third, few studies embed Wolbachia dynamics within integrated malaria transmission models, preventing estimation of epidemiological impact to assess Wolbachia's role in malaria control and elimination. Lessons from Wolbachia-based dengue control and parallel developments in gene drive provide an established framework, with actionable pathways for advancement. Addressing these priorities will be essential to guide safe, effective and scalable implementation of Wolbachia as a new malaria control intervention.

These gaps limit the ability to assess how environmental variability influences Wolbachia persistence and its epidemiological impact on malaria control.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Addressing these gaps will be essential to guide safe, effective, and scalable implementation of Wolbachia as a new malaria control intervention. Lessons from dengue control and parallel developments in gene drive provide an established framework for advancing Wolbachia-based strategies for malaria.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review evaluates the use of Wolbachia-based modified insect release interventions for malaria control, comparing them with Wolbachia-based dengue models and gene drive-based Anopheles models. The review highlights three major gaps: limited incorporation of context-dependent fitness effects, infrequent modelling of spatial heterogeneity, and lack of integration of Wolbachia dynamics into malaria transmission models. These limitations hinder the assessment of Wolbachia's potential for malaria control. The findings suggest that addressing these gaps is crucial for the safe and effective implementation of Wolbachia as a malaria intervention, drawing on lessons from dengue control and gene drive research.

elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 建模支持了沃尔巴克氏体在登革热控制中的部署,类似的框架可能适用于疟疾。然而,沃尔巴克氏体在按蚊中用于疟疾控制的应用仍处于起步阶段,其整合到整合的疟疾传播模型中的程度有限。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 发现了三个主要的证据缺口:与环境相关的适应性效应很少被纳入模型,空间异质性很少被建模,且很少有研究将沃尔巴克氏体动态嵌入到整合的疟疾传播模型中。这些缺口限制了评估环境变化如何影响沃尔巴克氏体持续性及其对疟疾控制的流行病学影响的能力。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 解决这些缺口对于指导沃尔巴克氏体作为新的疟疾控制干预措施的安全、有效和可扩展实施至关重要。从登革热控制的经验以及基因驱动的平行发展,为推进基于沃尔巴克氏体的疟疾控制策略提供了已建立的框架。

papers.abstract_zh: 沃尔巴克氏体是一种有前景的新干预措施,可用于疟疾控制。虽然建模支持了沃尔巴克氏体在登革热控制中的部署,但其在按蚊中的应用仍处于起步阶段。我们系统地回顾了使用PubMed和Embase数据库的疟疾中基于沃尔巴克氏体的改良昆虫释放动态传播模型。证据主要与一项平行的沃尔巴克氏体-埃及伊蚊范围综述中的沃尔巴克氏体模型进行比较,次要地与通过独立系统搜索识别出的基于基因驱动的按蚊模型进行比较。在纳入的110项研究中,发现了三个主要的证据缺口。首先,很少有模型纳入了与环境相关的适应性效应,许多模型假设高母体传播(MT)和胞质不相容性(CI),这限制了对环境变化如何影响沃尔巴克氏体持续性的评估。其次,尽管有证据表明蚊子的移动影响了沃尔巴克氏体的传播,但空间异质性很少被建模。第三,很少有研究将沃尔巴克氏体动态嵌入到整合的疟疾传播模型中,这阻碍了对沃尔巴克氏体在疟疾控制中的流行病学影响的估计。从沃尔巴克氏体在登革热控制中的经验以及基因驱动的平行发展,提供了一个已建立的框架,具有可操作的改进路径。解决这些优先事项对于指导沃尔巴克氏体作为新的疟疾控制干预措施的安全、有效和可扩展实施至关重要。

papers.title: Differential modulation of host cell Serine and Arginine-Rich (SR) protein and apoptotic factor BCL-2 gene expressions during Chandipura and Dengue virus infections
papers.abstract: Regulation of alternative splicing (AS) is important in controlling cellular functions. More than 95% human genes are alternatively spliced and AS is regulated by close to 100 splicing factors. Line of evidences suggest that virus infections alter the AS pattern of numerous host genes. In this study we have investigated Chandipura virus (CHPV) induced alteration of host cell SR protein gene expressions and determined if these changes have any effect on apoptotic factor BCL-2 levels,. CHPV is a negative stranded RNA virus which causes fever, brain encephalitis and death among young children with a case-fatality rate of 50%. Few studies were done in past to understand the roles of host factors in CHPV pathogenesis and no study was done on virus induced changes in AS. Our study showed that there is a down-regulation of SR proteins SRp55 and SRp75 expression levels significantly decreased in the CHPV infected Vero E6 cells compared to uninfected cells. For a comparison, we also looked at the levels of SRp55 and SRp75 in dengue virus (DENV) infected cells. Our results showed that SRp75 levels is unchanged whereas SRp55 levels increased in DENV infected cells. We have also determined the levels of large and small splice variants of apoptotic gene BCL-2 to find out possible correlation between the altered splicing factor expressions and virus infected cell death via apoptosis. Our data indicates that in CHPV infected cells, BCL-2 large splice variant expressions decreased as compared to uninfected cells. This is the first study of CHPV mediated alteration of splicing factor expressions and these results warrant further study with other viruses to better understand the global changes in host splicing events, cell survival, host immune response during virus infection.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为了解CHPV如何改变宿主剪接因子提供了重要信息,并可能有助于阐明其发病机制。它们还强调了进一步研究其他病毒类似效应的必要性,以及这些效应对细胞存活和免疫应答的潜在影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于使用Vero E6细胞进行体外分析,这可能无法完全代表人类感染情况。研究基于单一实验,因此其发现的可信度处于中等水平。

papers.abstract_zh: 替代剪接(AS)的调控在控制细胞功能方面具有重要意义。超过95%的人类基因会发生替代剪接,而AS由接近100种剪接因子调控。已有证据表明,病毒感染会改变大量宿主基因的剪接模式。本研究探讨了Chandipura病毒(CHPV)对宿主细胞SR蛋白基因表达的影响,并确定这些变化是否会影响凋亡因子BCL-2的水平。CHPV是一种负链RNA病毒,会导致年轻儿童出现发热、脑炎和死亡,其病死率高达50%。过去对宿主因子在CHPV感染中的作用了解甚少,且尚未有研究探讨病毒感染引起的剪接变化。我们的研究结果显示,在CHPV感染的Vero E6细胞中,SR蛋白SRp55和SRp75的表达水平显著下调。为了进行比较,我们还检测了登革病毒(DENV)感染细胞中SRp55和SRp75的水平。结果显示,在DENV感染的细胞中,SRp75水平未发生变化,而SRp55水平升高。我们还确定了凋亡基因BCL-2的大剪接变体和小剪接变体的水平,以探讨改变的剪接因子表达与病毒感染细胞凋亡之间的可能关联。我们的数据表明,在CHPV感染的细胞中,BCL-2大剪接变体的表达水平低于未感染细胞。这是第一项关于CHPV介导的剪接因子表达变化的研究,这些结果提示需要进一步研究其他病毒,以更好地理解病毒感染期间宿主剪接事件的全局变化、细胞存活以及免疫应答。

papers.title: Anti‐ZIKV IgG Subclass Profiles and Anti‐DENV IgG Are Associated With Neonatal Outcomes Following ZIKV Infection During Pregnancy
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Zika virus (ZIKV) is a flavivirus transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. Most infected individuals present mild symptoms; however, vertical transmission of ZIKV can lead to Congenital Zika Syndrome (CZS), which includes microcephaly, neurological, hearing, ophthalmological, and morphological abnormalities. Given the high prevalence of dengue virus (DENV) exposure and antibody cross‐reactivity among flaviviruses, understanding how maternal humoral antibody profiles relate to neonatal outcomes after ZIKV infection is important. In this exploratory study, we evaluated maternal and neonatal anti‐ZIKV total IgG, anti‐ZIKV IgG1 and anti‐ZIKV IgG3, and anti‐DENV IgG reactivity in relation to maternal–neonatal antibody patterns and neonatal outcomes. Samples from pregnant women and their newborns were collected in Brazil, including pregnancies with microcephaly and other clinical or imaging abnormalities. Anti‐ZIKV and anti‐DENV IgG reactivity was measured by ELISA. Lower neonatal anti‐ZIKV IgG3 reactivity was observed in pregnancies with ophthalmological abnormalities in the individual comparison, although this association did not remain significant after false discovery rate adjustment. Lower neonatal anti‐DENV IgG reactivity was observed in pregnancies with ophthalmological abnormalities and with any clinical or imaging abnormality, and both associations remained significant after false discovery rate adjustment. These exploratory associations are hypothesis‐generating and do not establish functional protection or a causal role for the measured antibody profiles.
authors: Ana Laura de Sene Amâncio Zara
